scenario_description:
Objective: Give a confirmed lantern-walk porch sendoff a small visual lift through a free mask-ribbon color consult if the borrowed mask can be handled within its limits.
Emerging Need: The consult offer appears before any mask use is definite; later the outing, color theme, and supply purchase make a matching consult useful during a narrow list window.
Decision Context: Stored costume-lending notes identify which mask is available, who holds it, and what reversible changes are permitted, while observable notices set timing and request details.
Consequence: Catching the window can add a thoughtful polish without changing the gathering; missing it leaves the sendoff and borrowed mask usable as they are.

parameter.subject: Lantern Walk week: free ribbon-color consults
parameter.body: Paper Moon Mask Studio will offer a few no-cost 10-minute ribbon-color consults during Lantern Walk week for neighbors refreshing an existing mask. Slots will be released on Thursday, February 12, and are for reversible ribbon or comb color only, not repairs or paid alterations.

parameter.content: If the Friday lantern walk actually comes together, I can bring a thermos and some silver beads for your porch. I will know my work schedule on Tuesday, so please do not count me in yet.

parameter.title: Lantern-walk porch sendoff
parameter.description: Meet on Lucia's porch before walking toward the Marigny lantern route. Casual blue-and-silver mask theme; wear a mask if one is handy.
Blue and silver tie ribbons and porch tea lights for the February 13 lantern-walk sendoff.

parameter.subject: Ribbon consult slots are open until 5:30 today
parameter.body: Six free Lantern Walk ribbon-color consult spots are open for Friday afternoon pickup. To request one, email studio@papermoonmasks.example by 5:30 p.m. today with your name, the mask nickname, and whether the consult is ribbon-only or comb-only. Confirmations go out in order received.

parameter.subject: Free ribbon consult list is closed
parameter.body: All six no-cost Lantern Walk ribbon-color consult spots have been claimed, and the request list closed at 5:30 p.m. We will still have ribbon bundles for sale on Friday, but no additional free consults are available this week.
